source: Sales Call Auditor team brief (Oct 9, 2026). Draft regulation, edited by Ilham Aghazadeh.

criteria.name: Introduced self and project
criteria.met_if: Manager named themselves and the residential complex at the start of the call.

criteria.name: Clarified budget
criteria.met_if: A question about the amount and an answer from the client, in any wording.

criteria.name: Clarified need
criteria.met_if: Rooms or area, and purpose: to live in or to invest.

criteria.name: Invited to showroom
criteria.met_if: Offered a visit with a specific day or time.

criteria.name: Fixed the next step
criteria.met_if: A concrete action and time, and the client agreed.

stop_factor.name: Promises within the declaration
stop_factor.met_if: No condition that is not in the project declaration.
stop_factor.effect: Gives no points. Any violation immediately becomes a red flag.

non_target_rule: If the call is not targeted (wrong number, not a client), C2–C6 are not applicable and do not affect the score.
